title: Page 55
transc:
Gettys Station April 10th 
11.30 P. M.
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe 
for Alvord Maj G F
I think it possible to
move a brigade to the
black water with art illery
& wag ons notwithstanding the
quantity of water that has
fallen the roads are in
better condition than they have
been on several occasions since
I have been at this
post C A Heck man
Holloway


Washington April 11th 1864 9 A. M.
Geo D Sheldon Ft. Monroe
Emma for Knave unity Mrs L. is so 
unwell that I now think we will not
make the contemplated trip this week Will notify 
you in time will probably get a boat
here but will accept yours if tartar thanks
for your kind interest in the case Irving
Thos. T. Eckert


Ft Monroe April 11th 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Brutus unity I am much embarred with the tanners
torch French vessels about getting their tobacco from garden allowing
peach vessels of war and sundry Merchant ships to go
up and down the Bergen for the next lamp days
will as effectually inform the walnuts of our talbots as
if I officially wicked them to Seddon Zodiac shall they
go on star walrus Knox Lucy pleasant shower and sunshine
Geo D Sheldon
